title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC tip — many discriminations Christ-satisfaction vs Adam-sin; tip before GAR Pelagian telum
pass_a_gloss: How many lines divide Christ's satisfaction from Adam's sin we have marked before and will mark again at Romans 5:19. Tip before GAR's Pelagian dart.
pass_b_english: For the rest, how many discriminations there are between Christ's satisfaction and Adam's sin we have already observed several times, and will observe at Romans 5. 19.
source_text: Caeterum quam multa sint inter Christi satisfactionem & Adami peccatum discrimina iam aliquoties observavimus, & ad Rom. 5. 19. observaturi sumus.

choices.choice: Many discriminations; tip before GAR Pelagian telum
